arguments.value: Check that the reverse proxy/port forward is pointing to the Pi’s VPN IP and the backend service is reachable on the port Caddy actually listens on (for example 10.0.8.10:80/443), not just the NAS port. Also verify the OpenVPN server has a route/allowed push for the VPN subnet back to the NAS and that the firewall permits inbound 81→NAS and NAS→10.0.8.10:80.
